inputSources.description: Gate 1 decisions: RAW-026/026a/026b content generation, RAW-027/027a/027b design generation, RAW-028/028a CV translation, RAW-029/029a interview translation, RAW-032/034 utility modules Phase 2, RAW-041 CV evidence viewer Phase 2

summary.productGoal: Automate end-to-end recruitment pipeline with AI-powered screening, scheduling, interview, and grading under HR Manager oversight
summary.coreProblem: Manual recruitment process does not scale at >200 jobs/month
outOfScope: CV/Interview translation integrated into Phase 1 core pipeline
CV Evidence Viewer deep-link detail in Phase 1/MVP
phase2Prototype: Recruitment content generation (copy/export/file/channel integration with HR approval)
AI design/mock generation (no real image provider required, HR approval required before use)
CV translation (vi/en/ja, original CV is source of truth, screening decisions trace to original)
CV Evidence Viewer utility (integrated on screening/final review screens, not MVP depth)

in.item: Candidate/CV Intake (Drive folder trigger/scan, multi-file PDF upload, manual single CV PDF + optional metadata; Excel metadata support only)
Job/JD Intake (manual job creation, JD text input, JD PDF/DOCX upload, Drive JD import, Sheet/Excel job requisition import, parsed JD approval)
AI-powered CV screening with scoring and explainability
Automated interview scheduling via Google Calendar
AI async interview (text chat, hybrid questions)
Candidate state machine and pipeline automation
External job source connector mock previews (ATS, job board, career site status only; no real integration)

out.item: CV/Interview translation integrated into Phase 1 core pipeline
out.reason: Utility modules are Phase 2 prototype standalone outside Phase 1/MVP core pipeline

out.item: CV Evidence Viewer deep-link detail in Phase 1/MVP
out.reason: Evidence viewer is Phase 2 prototype utility; screening/final review screens show summary only in MVP

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall import candidate CVs in batch from text-native PDF files using Google Drive folder trigger/scan as the primary path and multi-file PDF upload as the secondary path
functionalRequirements.rationale: Candidate intake is CV-driven and Excel is no longer the primary candidate source
acceptanceCriteria: Given PDF CVs are available in the configured Drive folder, When scan runs or trigger fires, Then valid PDF CVs are imported and invalid items are reported
Given HR uploads multiple PDF CVs, When import completes, Then each valid CV creates or updates a candidate CV version

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow HR Recruiter to manually create a candidate from a single CV PDF upload with optional metadata
functionalRequirements.rationale: Manual candidate creation still starts from the candidate CV
acceptanceCriteria: Given HR uploads one valid PDF CV and optional metadata, When submitted, Then candidate record and initial CV version are created

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall scan configured Google Drive CV folders and flag non-PDF files or nested subfolders as import errors visible to HR
functionalRequirements.rationale: Drive is the primary CV source and invalid items must not be silent
acceptanceCriteria: Given Drive folder contains invalid items, When scan completes, Then each invalid item appears in the import error report

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support Job/JD Intake through manual job creation, JD text input, JD PDF/DOCX upload, Google Drive JD import, and Sheet/Excel job requisition import
functionalRequirements.rationale: Job/JD source is a separate intake domain from Candidate/CV Intake
acceptanceCriteria: Given HR provides job/JD through any supported MVP source, When submitted, Then a job draft and original JD evidence/reference are created

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use LLM extraction on text-native PDF CV content to create a CandidateProfile linked to the original CV and CV version
functionalRequirements.rationale: Structured candidate profile is derived from original CV source of truth
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid text-native PDF CV, When extraction runs, Then CandidateProfile is created with extraction metadata and linked CV version

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall maintain Job/JD profiles separately from CandidateProfiles and use the HR-approved ParsedJDProfile as the operational source of truth for matching
functionalRequirements.rationale: Job source of truth differs from CV source of truth
acceptanceCriteria: Given parsed JD profile is approved, When screening runs, Then matching uses the approved ParsedJDProfile, not raw JD text alone

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall extract text content only from text-native PDF CV files for MVP processing
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid CV, When processing, Then full text extracted within 5s

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use AI to match CandidateProfile/CVVersion against approved ParsedJDProfile/ParsedCriteriaVersion and produce a matching score (0-100)
acceptanceCriteria: Given CV and JD, When screening, Then score 0-100 within 30s

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate summary of candidate strengths and weaknesses relative to JD
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening done, Then 3-5 strengths and 3-5 weaknesses listed

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall identify and flag critical risk factors in candidate profile
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening done, Then risk flags listed

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall list JD-required skills missing from CV
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening done, Then missing skills enumerated with importance

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall apply configurable matching weights (default: Skills 40%, Experience 30%, Language 20%, Education 10%)
acceptanceCriteria: Given custom weights, When screening, Then scoring uses those weights

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support bulk screening of multiple CVs against one JD
acceptanceCriteria: Given 50 CVs, When bulk screen, Then all processed

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall present screening results to HR Manager for approval
acceptanceCriteria: Given results ready, When HR Manager views, Then can approve/reject individually or bulk

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall handle unreadable/corrupted CV files gracefully
acceptanceCriteria: Given corrupted file, Then mark ERROR, do not block others

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall collect candidate availability via email form/link
acceptanceCriteria: Given approved candidate, When request sent, Then candidate can select slots

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall read interviewer free/busy from Google Calendar
acceptanceCriteria: Given GCal connected, When checking, Then free/busy read accurately

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall suggest optimal interview slots based on availability
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given availability data, Then suggest top 3 slots (earliest first, 30min buffer, within working hours 9-18 local timezone)

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR Manager approval before confirming schedule
acceptanceCriteria: Given suggested slots, When approved, Then proceed; if rejected, re-suggest

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall create Google Calendar events upon schedule approval
acceptanceCriteria: Given approved slot, Then GCal event created with all participants

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send confirmation emails via shared HR mailbox
acceptanceCriteria: Given confirmed, Then emails sent from hr@company.com

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send interview reminder emails
acceptanceCriteria: Given confirmed interview, When reminder time, Then email sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support multi-timezone scheduling
acceptanceCriteria: Given different TZs, Then correct local time shown

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate unique interview link per candidate
acceptanceCriteria: Given candidate ready, Then unique URL generated

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send interview invitation with link and 72h deadline
acceptanceCriteria: Given link generated, Then email sent with instructions

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall present 5-7 fixed interview questions per job
acceptanceCriteria: Given interview started, Then fixed questions shown sequentially

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate 2-3 AI follow-up questions based on answers
acceptanceCriteria: Given answer submitted, Then contextual follow-up generated

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support interview in Vietnamese, Japanese, and English
acceptanceCriteria: Given JD language, Then interview in matching language

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow async text answers within 72h deadline
acceptanceCriteria: Given link, Then progress saved across sessions, deadline enforced

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use AI to evaluate responses and generate assessment report
acceptanceCriteria: Given all answers, Then report with score, strengths, concerns, recommendation

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send reminder if interview not completed within 48h
acceptanceCriteria: Given 48h passed, Then reminder email sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow test import from Excel/JSON with questions and answer keys
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid file, Then test available for assignment

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send test assignment to candidate via email with link
acceptanceCriteria: Given TEST_PENDING, Then email sent with link and deadline

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall auto-grade MCQ against answer key with 100% accuracy
acceptanceCriteria: Given MCQ submission, Then score matches key exactly

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use AI to grade essays based on rubric (0-100)
acceptanceCriteria: Given essay + rubric, Then score 0-100 with justification

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall grade coding challenges via test cases and AI code quality review
acceptanceCriteria: Given code submission, Then test pass rate + quality score + feedback

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate consolidated test report with scores and pass/fail
acceptanceCriteria: Given all graded, Then report with section scores, total, pass/fail

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support configurable pass threshold per job (default 60%)
acceptanceCriteria: Given threshold set, Then pass/fail determined accordingly

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall auto-transition candidate state except at approval points
acceptanceCriteria: Given auto-transition state, When condition met, Then advances automatically

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR Manager approval at screening and scheduling stages
acceptanceCriteria: Given approval point reached, Then pipeline pauses, notification sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support bulk approval
acceptanceCriteria: Given multiple pending, Then batch approve/reject in one action

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send reminder after 24h if approval pending
acceptanceCriteria: Given >24h pending, Then reminder sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall never auto-cancel or auto-skip pending approvals
acceptanceCriteria: Given indefinite pending, Then only reminders, no auto-action

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall track and display candidate state throughout pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Given any candidate, Then current state and history visible on dashboard

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support candidate withdrawal at any stage
acceptanceCriteria: Given withdrawal, Then state=WITHDRAWN, pipeline stops, stakeholders notified

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send all candidate emails from shared HR mailbox
acceptanceCriteria: Given any candidate email, Then from=shared HR mailbox

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support configurable email templates
acceptanceCriteria: Given template configured, Then used with dynamic fields

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall notify HR Manager of pending actions
acceptanceCriteria: Given action required, Then notification within 1 min

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow HR to request AI-generated recruitment content based on job info and tone/style preferences
functionalRequirements.rationale: Reduce HR time drafting job ads
acceptanceCriteria: Given job info and tone setting, When HR requests content, Then 2-3 suggestions generated within 60s

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall present generated content as editable suggestions for HR review
acceptanceCriteria: Given content generated, When HR views, Then can edit inline and see changes

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support manual copy and export of approved content to file formats (TXT, DOCX)
acceptanceCriteria: Given content approved and export requested, Then copy to clipboard or download as file

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support channel integration for content publishing via connector interfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Given channel connectors configured, When HR publishes approved content, Then sent via connector API with status tracked

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR Manager approval before any content is exported, published, or shared
acceptanceCriteria: Given content generated, When export/publish attempted, Then approval required; unauthorized distribution blocked

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall track content version history including HR editor changes and approval decisions
acceptanceCriteria: Given content modified, When viewed later, Then version history shows all changes and approvers

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate mock/preview visual assets (banners, posters, social images) based on job content and design brief
acceptanceCriteria: Given job info and design parameters, When HR requests design, Then mock/preview image generated

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate design as mock/preview without requiring real external image generation API
functionalRequirements.rationale: No external design API dependency in Phase 2
acceptanceCriteria: Given design request, When processed, Then preview asset produced internally; no third-party design API required

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow HR to review, select, and approve generated designs
acceptanceCriteria: Given multiple design options, When HR reviews, Then can select best match and approve

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR Manager approval before any design asset is exported or used
acceptanceCriteria: Given design selected, When export/use requested, Then approval required; unapproved designs cannot be exported

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall translate CV text between Vietnamese, Japanese, and English
acceptanceCriteria: Given CV in source language (vi/en/ja), When translation requested, Then full CV translated to target language

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall preserve CV structure and formatting during translation
acceptanceCriteria: Given CV with sections/formatting, When translated, Then section structure and basic formatting preserved

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall mark translated CV as derived work and link to original CV
acceptanceCriteria: Given translation generated, Then record shows original CV reference and translation metadata

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall store translated CV with same access controls as original CV
acceptanceCriteria: Given translated CV created, When stored, Then access restricted to authorized roles; not shared externally

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support translated CV in screening and final review for HR review; screening decisions must trace to original CV
functionalRequirements.rationale: Translation is review aid, not decision basis
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening/review with translated CV, When decision made, Then decision record references original CV

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall display a visible notice that translated content is a translation and not the official record
acceptanceCriteria: Given translated CV displayed, When viewed, Then clear notice: Translation only -- refer to original CV

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall translate interview notes and transcripts between Vietnamese, Japanese, and English
acceptanceCriteria: Given interview notes in source language, When translation requested, Then notes/transcript translated to target language

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall store translated interview content with access controls restricted to HR roles
acceptanceCriteria: Given translated notes stored, When accessed, Then only authorized HR roles can view; not shared externally

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall link translated interview content back to original document
acceptanceCriteria: Given translation generated, Then record shows original interview reference and translator model version

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall display screening and final review screens with evidence summary (scores, flags, missing skills)
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening or review screen, When HR views candidate, Then evidence summary visible with key signals

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support navigation to CV evidence detail view (Phase 2) as integrated utility on screening/final review screens
acceptanceCriteria: Given summary on screening/review screen, When HR clicks to drill down, Then CV evidence detail opened as integrated view

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall display CV evidence detail as standalone viewer integrated into existing screens, without blocking primary review workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Given HR in review workflow, When opening evidence detail, Then workflow state preserved; detail shown as panel/modal

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall parse JD text or documents with LLM into a structured ParsedJDProfile for HR review
functionalRequirements.rationale: JD must be normalized before it becomes matching criteria
acceptanceCriteria: Given JD source is submitted, When parsing completes, Then required criteria fields and parse confidence are available for HR review

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR approval of ParsedJDProfile before the JD can be used for screening or matching
functionalRequirements.rationale: Prevent unreviewed AI-parsed criteria from driving screening decisions
acceptanceCriteria: Given parsed JD is pending review, When screening is requested, Then screening is blocked until approval
Given HR rejects parsed JD, Then HR can edit/resubmit or re-upload/re-parse

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support Job/JD versioning and ParsedCriteriaVersion history for screening reproducibility
functionalRequirements.rationale: Screening results must be reproducible across JD and criteria changes
acceptanceCriteria: Given JD is updated, Then a new JD version is created
Given weights or criteria are tuned without changing original JD, Then a new parsedCriteriaVersion is created

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall display prototype-only mock connector status and import previews for ATS, job board, and career site job sources without real external API integration
functionalRequirements.rationale: External sources are useful for prototype demonstration but not real MVP integration
acceptanceCriteria: Given HR opens external source connectors, Then mock status and requisition preview fields are visible and clearly marked as mock

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall store screening trace references to candidateId, cvVersionId, jobId, jdVersionId, and parsedCriteriaVersion
functionalRequirements.rationale: Cross-domain traceability connects CV source and JD source for every screening result
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening result is generated, Then all CV/JD version reference fields are stored with the result

functionalRequirements.requirementStatement: The system shall provide a unified Assessment Plan Setup module per approved Job/JD criteria version
functionalRequirements.rationale: Interview and test setup must share one evaluation source of truth
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given an approved ParsedJDProfile, When HR opens Assessment Setup, Then the plan shows jobId, jdVersionId, parsedCriteriaVersion, shared rubric, interview setup, and test setup

functionalRequirements.requirementStatement: The system shall support versioned shared evaluation rubric and weights at assessment plan level
functionalRequirements.rationale: Interview and test grading must remain reproducible and comparable
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given HR edits criteria or weights, When saved as a new version, Then assessmentPlanVersionId and rubricVersionId change while prior outputs remain traceable

functionalRequirements.requirementStatement: The system shall configure AI Interview question set version inside the assessment plan
functionalRequirements.rationale: Candidate interview execution must trace to the approved setup version
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given HR selects interview questions, When plan is approved, Then interview sessions store interviewQuestionSetVersionId and shared assessment trace IDs

functionalRequirements.requirementStatement: The system shall configure Test/Assignment definition version inside the assessment plan
functionalRequirements.rationale: Test grading must trace to the approved setup version
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given HR selects test definition, When plan is approved, Then test submissions and grading results store testDefinitionVersionId and shared assessment trace IDs

functionalRequirements.requirementStatement: The system shall display prototype-only local/mock state for assessment setup without real API, LLM, OCR, or external integrations
functionalRequirements.rationale: UAT needs visible coverage without production integration behavior
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given HR changes setup values, When previewing the prototype, Then the UI updates locally and clearly represents mock setup data only

dataRequirements.businessMeaning: Structured candidate profile derived from original CV

dataRequirements.businessMeaning: Candidate source of truth and provenance

dataRequirements.dataNeed: Job, OriginalJDDocument, JDVersion, ParsedJDProfile, and ParsedCriteriaVersion
dataRequirements.businessMeaning: Job/JD source records and approved matching criteria

dataRequirements.dataNeed: Screening results with candidateId, cvVersionId, jobId, jdVersionId, and parsedCriteriaVersion
dataRequirements.businessMeaning: Reproducible CV/JD matching output
Async interview records
Test performance
Pipeline audit trail

Sent emails record
Content drafts and approval records
Design asset versions and approval records
Translated candidate documents
Translated interview records
Screening/final review evidence display
LLM extraction output, confidence, errors, and metadata for CV processing
Version history for candidate CV updates
Sheet/Excel requisition import records for Job/JD Intake
Prototype-only ATS/job board/career site connector status and preview data
Canonical relationship between candidate and job for screening/application tracking

dataRequirements.dataNeed: AssessmentPlan, AssessmentPlanVersion, RubricVersion, InterviewQuestionSetVersion, and TestDefinitionVersion
dataRequirements.businessMeaning: Unified assessment setup source of truth and versioned traceability for interview/test execution

integrationRequirements.purpose: Drive folder trigger/scan for CV PDF intake and Drive JD import
integrationRequirements.dataExchanged: File metadata, Drive links, text-native PDF CV content, JD document references
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Retry with backoff; flag invalid files/subfolders; alert HR after repeated failures
Queue and retry; alert on failure

integrationRequirements.purpose: CV screening, interview evaluation, test grading
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Retry with backoff; queue if rate limited; route sustained failures to manual review

integrationRequirements.purpose: Recruitment content generation, CV translation, interview transcript/notes translation
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Retry with backoff; queue if rate limited; content gated by HR approval before export/publish

integrationRequirements.purpose: Generate preview/mock design assets (banners, posters, social images)
integrationRequirements.dataExchanged: Design brief + job content -> mock/preview image asset
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Fail gracefully; no external design API required; output is mock asset for HR approval

integrationRequirements.purpose: Publish approved content to external channels
integrationRequirements.dataExchanged: Approved content + channel config -> connector API call
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Queue if connector unavailable; track publish status; require HR approval before dispatch

integrationRequirements.purpose: Import job requisitions as Job/JD Intake source and optional CV metadata support
integrationRequirements.dataExchanged: Spreadsheet rows, requisition metadata, optional candidate metadata
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Validate required columns; import valid rows and report invalid rows

integrationRequirements.purpose: Display prototype-only ATS/job board/career site connector status and import previews
integrationRequirements.dataExchanged: Mock requisition ID, job title, department, location, work mode, employment type, seniority, language, compensation, hiring manager, headcount, source, last sync status, JD summary
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: No real API call; clearly mark mock state and unavailable integrations

constraints.constraint: Internal HR only, no multi-tenant
constraints.impact: Single-org data model

constraints.constraint: MVP CV intake accepts text-native PDF CV files only; OCR is excluded
constraints.impact: Scanned/image-only CV files are rejected or flagged for HR

constraints.constraint: Depends on Google Workspace
constraints.impact: All scheduling/email requires Google APIs

constraints.constraint: Approval no timeout, only reminders
constraints.impact: Pipeline can stall at approval points

constraints.constraint: MVP = full pipeline
constraints.impact: All 5 stages must work at launch

constraints.constraint: Content/Design/Translation/CV evidence viewer are Phase 2 prototype standalone; excluded from Phase 1/MVP core pipeline
constraints.impact: Do not implement Phase 2 standalone tools in first release

constraints.constraint: Generated recruitment content requires HR review and approval before copy/export, file export, or channel publishing
constraints.impact: Prevent unvetted AI content from being published or distributed

constraints.constraint: Generated design/mock assets require HR review and approval before use
constraints.impact: AI-generated designs are mock/preview; HR approval required before use

constraints.constraint: Original CV PDF is the source of truth for candidate information; extracted profiles/translations are derived artifacts
constraints.impact: Screening and evidence must trace to original CV/CVVersion

constraints.constraint: CV translation and interview transcript/notes translation are Phase 2 prototype; original documents stored securely
constraints.impact: Privacy and security for translated candidate documents

constraints.constraint: Content publishing supports manual copy/export, file export, and channel integration -- all require HR approval
constraints.impact: Three content export paths; all gated behind HR review

constraints.constraint: AI design generation is mock image prototype; does not require real image provider or third-party AI design service
constraints.impact: Standalone mock/generation; no external design API dependency in Phase 2

constraints.constraint: OCR is excluded unless explicitly in scope; all MVP file processing uses text-native PDF/DOCX only
constraints.impact: OCR boundary; Phase 2 may expand file handling scope

constraints.constraint: Excel is optional metadata/support for CV intake and not the primary candidate source
constraints.impact: Batch candidate import centers on PDF CV files

constraints.constraint: CV versioning is required; new CV versions flag HR for manual re-screen decision and do not auto re-screen later-stage candidates
constraints.impact: Prevents unintended pipeline disruption from updated CVs

constraints.constraint: HR-approved ParsedJDProfile is the operational source of truth for matching; original JD text/file is evidence/reference
constraints.impact: Matching cannot rely on unapproved parsed JD or raw JD alone

constraints.constraint: Job/JD versioning and ParsedCriteriaVersion history are required
constraints.impact: Screening must remain reproducible across JD updates and criteria tuning

constraints.constraint: Screening results must store candidateId, cvVersionId, jobId, jdVersionId, and parsedCriteriaVersion
constraints.impact: Cross-domain traceability requirement

constraints.constraint: ATS, job board, and career site connectors are prototype-only mock UI/status previews with no real external API integration in MVP
constraints.impact: Avoids implying production external integrations

constraints.constraint: A ParsedJDProfile must be HR-approved before the JD can be used for screening/matching
constraints.impact: Human oversight for AI-parsed job criteria

constraints.constraint: Assessment Plan Setup is prototype-only local/mock state in this phase and must not imply real persistence, LLM generation, OCR, or external integration
constraints.impact: Keeps UAT coverage separate from production API/integration commitments

constraints.constraint: Interview and test outputs must store assessmentPlanId, assessmentPlanVersionId, rubricVersionId, and the relevant question/test definition version IDs
constraints.impact: Preserves reproducibility from approved JD criteria through candidate assessment outputs

conflicts.conflict: No timeout may stall pipeline at scale
conflicts.decision: Accepted: reminder-only is business decision. Monitor queue depth.

checks.notes: Use-case, state machine, approval, AI result, integration, and file/OCR contracts added as handoff prerequisites

validation.decision: Accepted for discovery and BA refinement; hold for solution design sign-off and development handoff until P0 contract gaps are resolved.

openQuestions.question: AI matching weights confirmed by business?
Coding test sandbox: in-browser or external?
Exact fixed interview question count (5 or 7)?
Google Drive watch folder path and naming convention?
Content generation: which specific channels (social media, job boards) will be integrated in Phase 2? Channel list and provider details needed for connector design.
Design generation: what asset types and size formats will Phase 2 mock generator support (banner, poster, social image dimensions)?
CV evidence viewer: what level of detail is needed beyond summary in Phase 2 (full CV text, evidence spans, AI reasoning trace)?
What exact confidence threshold routes AI results to manual review?
Who is backup approver for escalation?
What is the Google Drive folder ownership and webhook renewal responsibility?
What is the Calendar reschedule/cancel policy after event creation?
What coding sandbox/runtime is approved for code execution?
What retention/deletion period applies to CVs, transcripts, and test submissions?

useCaseContracts.name: Candidate Sourcing
useCaseContracts.trigger: Manual form, Excel upload, or Google Drive watch file
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: Successful import sets state IMPORTED; invalid/duplicate records require review or ERROR

useCaseContracts.name: Interview Scheduling
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: AVAILABILITY_PENDING -> SCHEDULING_PENDING_APPROVAL -> INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED only after approval

useCaseContracts.name: AI Interview
useCaseContracts.trigger: Interview scheduled or AI interview stage reached
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: AI_INTERVIEW_PENDING -> AI_INTERVIEW_COMPLETED; incomplete/expired sessions require reopen or manual decision

useCaseContracts.name: Test Grading
useCaseContracts.trigger: Candidate completes interview and test is assigned
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: TEST_PENDING -> TEST_GRADED -> FINAL_REVIEW; HR Manager can override with reason

approvalMatrix.escalation: 48h to backup HR Manager if configured
24h to backup HR Manager if configured
approvalMatrix.automationRule: Never create Calendar event before approval

approvalMatrix.escalation: 72h to backup HR Manager if configured
approvalMatrix.automationRule: Never mark PASSED/FAILED solely from AI

approvalMatrix.escalation: Admin review for persistent technical failure

aiQualityMetrics.target: Human reviewer agreement >= 80% on validation dataset
False reject sample review performed monthly
No release if prompt/rubric score drift exceeds agreed threshold
100% low-confidence outputs route to manual review

fileOcrBoundary.cv: Text-native PDF and DOCX only; scanned/image-only files rejected in MVP
fileOcrBoundary.jd: Direct text, text-native PDF, and DOCX only; scanned/image-only files rejected in MVP
fileOcrBoundary.parseConfidence: Low-confidence extraction routes to manual review
